description.value: Cue's is the Okanagan's premier billiard room, featuring Diamond pool tables and Aramith billiard balls in a locally owned venue on Main Street in the heart of downtown Penticton. The kitchen serves sandwiches, burgers on Cob's Bread, and more — billed as one of downtown's best-kept food secrets — alongside a dog-friendly licensed patio overlooking Main Street. The venue regularly hosts tournaments and pool leagues for players of all skill levels, and is just a few blocks from Lake Okanagan.
